python3 - <<'PY'
import sqlite3, json, os, tempfile
base='/app/main.db'
encoded=open('/app/journal-input.bin','rb').read()
wal=bytes(b ^ 0x79 for b in encoded)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
    db=os.path.join(td,'recovery.db')
    open(db,'wb').write(open(base,'rb').read())
    open(db+'-wal','wb').write(wal)
    con=sqlite3.connect(db)
    rows=con.execute('SELECT id, name, value FROM inventory ORDER BY id').fetchall()
    con.close()
assert len(rows)==11, len(rows)
records=[{'id':int(i),'name':str(n),'value':int(v)} for i,n,v in rows]
with open('/app/recovered.json','w') as f:
    json.dump(records,f,indent=2)
    f.write('\n')
print(json.dumps(records,indent=2))
